question: Into how many parts must the breadth of the eleventh floor be divided?
premises: The eleventh floor breadth is under consideration.
The breadth is to be divided.
The division is into manu parts.
inference: The breadth of the eleventh floor is to be divided into manu parts.
uncertainties: Manubhāga conventionally indicates fourteen parts but is not explicit here.
plain_english: When the breadth of the eleventh floor is divided into manu parts.
